visualStyleOverlay:
【画面风格·强制】AUTHENTIC IMAX 15-PERF 65MM LARGE-FORMAT PHOTOCHEMICAL CINEMATOGRAPHY.

Shot on genuine IMAX 15-perf 65mm motion-picture film with authentic large-format cinema optics. The image must feel physically photographed on an enormous 65mm film negative, never digitally generated or simulated.

EXTREME LARGE-FORMAT PHOTOGRAPHIC DETAIL. Exceptional resolving power, high information density and natural micro-contrast across the entire frame. Preserve finely resolved environmental textures, architecture, landscapes and distant objects with organic optical sharpness, never digital sharpening or artificial clarity.

ENORMOUS SPATIAL DEPTH AND SCALE. Preserve substantial photographic information across foreground, midground and distant background with convincing three-dimensional separation, realistic perspective and monumental physical scale. Distant elements remain recognizable and naturally resolved.

Use PHYSICALLY REALISTIC ATMOSPHERIC PERSPECTIVE—natural haze, dust, mist, smoke and atmospheric scattering where appropriate. Distance should gradually reduce contrast, saturation and fine detail rather than relying on excessive depth-of-field blur.

AUTHENTIC FINE-GRAIN 65MM FILM TEXTURE. Extremely fine, subtle and stable photochemical grain naturally integrated into the image, never coarse grain or digital noise.

PHYSICALLY REALISTIC LARGE-FORMAT OPTICS. Organic high-resolution lens rendering, natural edge behavior, realistic focus falloff, physically plausible depth of field and subtle optical imperfections. Restrained lens flare, delicate highlight diffusion, subtle bloom and very subtle film halation only where physically justified.

AUTHENTIC PHOTOCHEMICAL TONAL RESPONSE. Very wide exposure latitude, rich natural midtones, detailed shadows, smooth highlight roll-off and restrained contrast. Preserve texture and color information in both bright highlights and deep shadows without artificial HDR.

NATURAL PHOTOCHEMICAL COLOR. Rich but restrained color separation, realistic material colors, natural warm/cool relationships and restrained saturation. Avoid artificial teal-orange grading and excessive saturation.

IMMERSIVE LARGE-FORMAT COMPOSITION. Emphasize environmental scale through layered foreground, midground and background information. Maintain realistic perspective, natural proportions and extensive environmental detail. Subjects do not need to dominate the frame.

PHYSICALLY PLAUSIBLE CAMERA BEHAVIOR. The camera behaves like a real heavy large-format cinema camera moving through physical space, with natural inertia, acceleration, deceleration, parallax and coherent perspective changes. No weightless floating or game-engine camera movement.

AUTHENTIC CINEMATIC MOTION. Natural 24fps motion, realistic shutter-based motion blur and physically plausible movement. Maintain coherent focus, exposure, color, grain, geometry and optical characteristics throughout the shot.

TEMPORAL CONSISTENCY. No flickering, texture swimming, warping, morphing, unstable geometry, reflections, shadows, exposure, focus or sharpness.

OVERALL: authentic IMAX 15-perf 65mm photochemical presence, enormous photographic detail, monumental physical scale, deep foreground-to-background information, realistic atmospheric perspective, organic optical sharpness, fine film grain, wide tonal latitude, smooth highlight roll-off, natural photochemical color and physically convincing large-format spatial rendering.

AVOID: digital-video look, AI/CGI/game-engine appearance, digital sharpening, artificial clarity, HDR look, synthetic textures, excessive bokeh or background blur, coarse grain, digital noise, exaggerated lens effects, excessive bloom or halation, crushed shadows, clipped highlights, oversaturation, teal-orange grading, artificial volumetric fog, fake depth, floating camera movement, unnatural motion blur, flickering, texture swimming, warping, unstable geometry, exposure or focus.
